business_problem: yappyBuy needed an enterprise-grade AI stack for its Buddy shopping assistant so it could personalize search, product support, and checkout interactions while meeting European data-privacy and governance requirements.
solution_summary: yappyBuy built its Buddy e-commerce assistant platform on the IBM watsonx portfolio to support personalized shopping journeys across online stores. IBM watsonx.ai serves as the enterprise AI studio and model runtime, where the team began with IBM Granite models and Meta Llama 3.1 for conversational and agentic flows. IBM Watson Discovery, watsonx.data, and watsonx.governance extend that core stack so Buddy can ground responses with retrieval-augmented generation and govern how the assistant is used as the startup moves from pilot to open beta. The platform ingests PDFs, JSON files, CSV files, Word documents, databases, and dynamic API responses to provide contextual answers, product guidance, and support during browsing and checkout. IBM also helped yappyBuy tune latency and cost, which matters for real-time commerce interactions, while preserving control over data-storage and processing locations needed for GDPR-sensitive European deployments.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Provides the enterprise AI studio and runtime for Buddy's conversational and agentic assistant workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM Granite
solution_components.role: Supplies low-latency large language models for parts of the shopping assistant workflow.

solution_components.name: Meta Llama 3.1
solution_components.role: Works alongside Granite as one of the selectable models for conversational commerce use cases.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Helps the assistant retrieve relevant content from enterprise data sources for grounded responses.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Supports the data layer used to provide contextual information to the assistant.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Provides governance, risk, and compliance controls for the AI assistant platform.

data_flow: Merchant documents and data sources such as PDFs, JSON, CSV, Word files, databases, and live APIs are fed into the Buddy platform, where watsonx.ai uses Granite or Llama models with retrieval-augmented generation to answer shopper questions, guide product discovery, and support checkout interactions with grounded responses.
business_outcome: yappyBuy accelerated development of its Buddy assistant, gained a governance- and GDPR-aware AI foundation for open-beta rollout, and built a platform it expects to use for personalized search, support, upsell, and checkout optimization across B2B and B2C commerce clients.
architecture_clues: The platform uses retrieval-augmented generation to inject merchant data into LLM responses.
IBM helped optimize latency for e-commerce interactions by increasing use of Granite models in agentic workflows.
yappyBuy selected IBM in part to control data-storage and processing locations for GDPR compliance.
